9052.name: Cosmic Big Lotto
9052.lore: The marketing tactics for the Cosmic Big Lotto, sold by the Interastral Peace Corporation's Marketing Development Department, is as passionate and hot-blooded as Oswaldo Schneider himself. You just need one galactic currency to bet on your luck and become a trader in the experience of making dreams, where everyone has a chance to become a cosmic tycoon and join the business structure. Under Oswaldo Schneider's marketing strategy, few new worlds are able to resist such temptations — They eagerly join the Interastral Peace Corporation's universal business structure to win an entry ticket, obtaining the right to operate the Cosmic Big Lotto in their own realms.
9052.desc: After destroying destructible objects, there is a small chance of receiving <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Curio, but also a small chance of destroying this Curio and all allies losing <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of their current HP

9053.name: Silver Coin of Discord
9053.lore: The Technology Division of the Interastral Peace Corporation is adept at unearthing products with commercial potential. When the interstellar communication network was just being established and the supply of antennas fell short of demand, the IPC quickly recognized the latent need for this item in the cosmic market. An ingenious plan was born: Since silver's exceptional malleability allowed it to be stretched from one gram into yards of antenna, a researcher devised a Silver Coin of Discord that split itself infinitely, dramatically increasing the quantity of silver available to meet demands. The IPC then melted these coins into antennas and exported them throughout various star systems, enormously advancing interplanetary communications.
9053.desc: Immediately gains Cosmic Fragments equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the Cosmic Fragments currently in possession.

9054.name: Interastral Big Lotto
9054.lore: How do you make a business model last? After getting rave reviews for their Cosmic Big Lotto, the Interastral Peace Corporation's Business Consolidation Department followed Oswaldo Schneider's product vision and put the Interastral Big Lotto on the market, hoping that it would bring them success as well. They even connected eighty-six complementary industrial production chains and promoted them as a single entity. However, although the "Lotto Goddess" Beatrice Mellanine the IPC wished to develop as their spokesperson for their product perished due to reasons unknown, the IPC still reaped a windfall of credits in the end!
9054.desc: After destroying destructible objects, there is a small chance of receiving <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> random Blessing(s), but also a small chance of destroying this Curio and causing all team members to lose all Energy and Technique Points.

9059.name: A Pinch of Bearded Gunpowder
9059.lore: Compared to currencies of stone, wood, gold, or supernium metals, the nomadic miners are more obsessed with the excavation of Aether. There was a period when they were infatuated with the sensation of digging vast quantities of Aether using their bare hands while in the mines, but these experiences brought calamity upon them. Several large-stature miners finally met their ends via exploding gunpowder in unknown areas, while only a short and small miner managed to survive. Its beard henceforth always flickered with a pinch of flame.
9059.desc: Increases the number of Weighted Curios that can be equipped by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>

9066.name: Joyous Incense
9066.lore: While watching the Mourning Actors' performance, a Masked Fool suddenly had a wild thought: Would he create an unrivaled joke if he added some small surprises to the Actors' soothing incense burner? He lit up half of his own mask and tossed it into the incense burner, then calmly returned to the audience's seats and watched the Actors clapping to the annihilation of the Morrowen Kingdom. When the incense was burnt out, the Actors wailed in anguish, feeling profound guilt at their mockery of a dead world. Yet this Fool busted out in laughter and is still boasting this joyful farce to his peers at the Tavern to this day.
9066.desc: Gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> random Equation(s) when obtaining this Curio. When entering combat in a/an "#{room_comp_type:1}" Domain, increases all enemies' Max HP by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> and ATK by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> for every inactive Equation

9068.name: Tawot Cards
9068.lore: People have always loved to recount the story of the Riddler, Baden Babbibalo Bala. Using <unbreak>109</unbreak> different riddles, he created a card set named "Tawot" and scattered it all over the universe, using it to shroud the future of intelligent races in layers of fog. When those who call themselves fortune-tellers flip open the same cards, they make different interpretations, speak subtly varied words, and decipher one question about fate after another. That is when Enigmata quietly takes root — It doesn't seem to have changed anything, yet it seems to have changed everything.
9068.desc: Increases all allies' SPD by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. This Curio is discarded after <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> battle(s)

9081.name: Unknown Lost Property
9081.lore: Nine Amber Eras ago, an infamous thief was arrested in the Alda planetary system. Before he was arrested, he had vowed that he would steal the thing that the people of Alda hold most precious in their lives. What no one could comprehend was that although the thief never stated what exactly their target was, they repeatedly asserted during trial that they were already successful with the announced burglary. Unaware of what had been stolen from them, the people of Alda became extremely panicked about what it was that they had lost, and the whole planetary system fell into deep mourning. Though it seemed like they had not actually lost anything, they could not help but worry what was most precious to them had been stolen.
9081.desc: When entering a Domain, there is a chance to gain <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> random Escapade-type Domain(s) and discard this Curio

9083.name: Ancient Communications
9083.lore: Before the creation of ultraremote sensing, pheromone communication among the Swarm was considered the most effective form of communication in the universe. During the Swarm Disaster, a group of bounty hunters that pursued worker bugs captured lone Afterglow Stings and modified them into frontline communications devices. With varying levels of stimulation, pheromone sensors that ignore distance would cause the insect to change color in real time and allow for simple information exchange. With this secret code, the bounty hunters became more and more courageous on the battlefield, until they came face-to-face with the Afterglow Swarm King attracted by the pheromones.
9083.desc: Attach a "#{room_attribute:110}" or "#{room_attribute:111}" beacon to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> designated "#{room_comp_type:3}" Domain(s).

9085.name: Peace Box
9085.lore: A ballot box used to mediate interstellar conflict. According to the user's wishes, you could obtain pretty much anything from within. An aether-edited virus code, a portable firearm with massive destructive power, a fleet of spaceships built by the tiny Thermians, white flag inclusive. Though they regularly pop up incongruously across all corners of interstellar theaters of war, proclaiming peace in the name of Equilibrium, these boxes calling themselves Peace will never bring peace — Just like how everyone knows they are the work of the Masked Fools.
9085.desc: After expanding <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Equation(s) of <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>-star(s) or rarer, obtains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> random Blessing(s). This effect can be triggered up to <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> times.

9086.name: Genius Society's Dangerous Gossip
9086.lore: "What does Polka actually look like?" Members of the fan club have always been curious about what Polka Kakamond really looks like. The possibility of erasing all her portraits across the universe aside, the Lord of Silence has appeared multiple times in history but never left even the most meager trail. Some believe that Polka merely slew all who set eyes upon her. Others say that she borrowed the power of Enigmata or Nihility to scrub all traces of her existence. Finally, a fervent fan's conjecture received everyone's acknowledgment — that perhaps Polka's face has been a haze of indiscernible features to begin with.
9086.desc: Unable to obtain Cosmic Fragments. For each <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments lost because of this Curio's effect, obtains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> random Curio(s) of <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>- to <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak>-star rarity. The Curio is destroyed after obtaining a total of <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> Curio(s) in this way.

9088.name: Doomsday Compound Eye — Early Access Version
9088.lore: Though the Finality's fluctuating murmurs often leave the Omen Vanguards in a state of wracked dizziness, their clairvoyant eyes remain a miracle that organic life has coveted since their birth. With the aid of a hacker friend, the Omen Vanguard Endin briefly transferred the divine blessing into an ocular device, allowing its user's eyes to project into the near-future. The oblivious hacker puts on the device as Endin snickers and their sight leaps to the Punklord an Amber Era later. He sees the game that myriad hackers had been clamoring for, with a line of words blown up above it: "On sale soon." Is this also not a form of doomsday to a hacker?
9088.desc: When obtaining this Curio, immediately obtains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Blessing(s) from the Path with the most Blessings in possession. Cosmic Fragments required to overwrite Blessings and Equations increase by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>

9089.name: Towat Cards
9089.lore: Dr. Riddle always styled himself as the archrival of Riddler Baden Babbibalo Bala. Using twenty-eight types of grammatical mistakes and thirty-six semantic changes to create a set of Towat cards, replacing soothsayers' Tawot cards with his invention instead. The chaos from the disarray of word sequences and discourse ultimately replaced the ambiguous reality with the divination's declared truth. When everything becomes jarringly paradoxical before you, it may not be the world that has changed, but the eyes of those who see it.
9089.desc: The Third Plane's boss is "Savage God, Mad King, Incarnation of Strife (Complete)." When entering combat in the Third Plane's "#{room_comp_type:1}" Domain, DMG dealt by all allies increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>

9093.name: Robe of The Beauty
9093.lore: The entire universe bowed before the grace of the Knights of Beauty while they still traversed the skies. These noble knights who chased beauty wore resplendent gold and silver armor, and donned magnificent robes woven from silk and starlight. They had divinely beautiful features under their helmets. Even in the current era when the Beauty had already faded, those who had once witnessed the magnificence of the knights still believe Idrila will one day return.

When entering "#{room_comp_type:3}", "#{room_comp_type:2}", or "#{room_comp_type:1}" Domains, obtain Cosmic Fragments equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of the Cosmic Fragments currently possessed.

9096.name: Obliteration Wick Trimmer
9096.lore: If this candle wick trimmer is used to cut a wick, the angry anti-matter flames will ignite the candle, and the entire candlestick will be obliterated within seconds under the intense particle collisions. Exothermic reactions will be immediately triggered if this trimmer grazes your skin. Any parts of the body that the trimmer touches will instantly turn into antiprotons, reverberate throughout the body, and then scatter.
9096.desc: Destructible objects appear more frequently, and rewards obtained from destroying them are doubled. When entering combat, all allies' DMG dealt increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for every destructible object destroyed, and all allies' Max HP increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> for every treasure opened

9098.name: Plaguenest
9098.lore: The infamous Jepella Brotherhood used live biological weapons when they invaded the Lindgano star system. The virus that causes genes to self-destruct makes infected cells consume each other within the host's body, creating appalling calamities. However, the endless multiplication made the horde of living beings within the Nest Capital soon go out of control. Driven berserk, they turned on the Brotherhood and devoured the invaders' camp, making these thugs have no chance but to give up the brethren embroiled in it, discarding what they could to stay alive. Some claimed the Ever-Flame Mansion was behind this event, with the evidence being the unending death feud between the two organizations that followed in days to come.
9098.desc: Immediately gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> random Negative Curio(s). When entering a Domain, randomly loses up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Negative Curio(s) and gains an equal number of random Blessings. For every 1 Negative Curio lost this way, increases all allies' DMG dealt by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> when entering combat.

9101.name: Do as the Locals Do
9101.lore: The bodies of organic life are extremely fragile things. Extreme gravity, toxic air, deep ocean pressure — these things that are no more than daily realities for natives become trials of survival for any visitor. According to the Astral Express's data bank, a number of former technician Nameless worked together to create a clay doll that was capable of free transformation. They could simulate the physical form of native citizens and connect to the senses of their controller to allow the trailblazing journey to continue through even the harshest environments through long-distance operations. Due to their lack of realism, clay doll exploration was quickly abandoned by the Nameless, but this technology became a huge boom in the field of interstellar tourism, allowing the IPC to make massive profits.
9101.desc: More Amusement Facilities will appear in "#{room_comp_type:6}" Domains. Increase the chance of extra Amusement Facilities appearing in "#{room_comp_type:3}", "#{room_comp_type:5}", "#{room_comp_type:2}", "#{room_comp_type:8}" and "#{room_comp_type:7}" Domains. Special Blessed Dreamy Slots and Curio Wheel will appear with increased use chances. For every use of the Amusement Facilities, increases CRIT DMG dealt by all allies by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

9102.name: By Any Means Necessary
9102.lore: As one of the powerful adversaries to fictional entities, genetic analysis by geneticists has long served as a final gambit against falsified fossils. However, it is clear to see that History Fictionologists have come up with a way to counter this. By taking genetic sequences as vessels for stories they wish to compose, they dedicate themselves with greater determination than any scholar and compile perfect molecular evolution trees, bringing the current species system into complete disarray. Bananas become amphibians and Wubbaboos were classified into birds. Unreliable data already illustrate that with more and more fossils becoming tainted with the scent of Enigmata, the influence of the History Fictionologist within biological fields is increasing exponentially.
9102.desc: When receiving 1-star/2-star/3-star rarity Curios, immediately obtains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>/<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>/<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments. For every 1-star/2-star/3-star Curio in possession, increases the ATK of ally targets by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak> when entering combat.

9103.name: Hero's Triumphant Return
9103.lore: Unlike the History Fictionologists who bring disaster across the cosmos, the kingdom of Kali only welcomes the laughter of children. They traverse the flux of pineapple juice, the storms of cotton candy whiffs, arriving at the moss-laden evil dragon's castle, trusty sword in hand, to wrest it of its treasures. But fiction will always fade away — The wails of children summon their guardians, and the children scorn imagination when they grow up. Thus, Enigmata ceases to exist. Young lads and lasses startle upright on their beds, waking from their dreams of brandished blades. Only the dusty-edged sword beside them remembers the glories of knights vanquishing evil.
9103.desc: When entering combat, deals DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of its Max HP to the enemy target with the highest HP and obtains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments. This DMG dealt is halved in "#{room_comp_type:1}" Domains

9116.name: "Revelrous" Rainbowmaker
9116.lore: Following the machine era calendar, on this day at six in the morning, the invasive "Revelrous" entered the mind of a mono-horned beast in the Mechanical City. Only paltry few unmodified animals remained in the city. Hence, fueled by the "Revelrous" contagion, the mono-horned beast was able to overcome all manner of despairing defeats, awkward incidents, and crippling moments of dread. Sadness became joy for it, pain became pleasure, and pressure became a trigger for secreting excitatory neurotransmitters — Until one day it realized it had taught itself how to convert "mood" into a freely adjustable parameter. Thereafter, its confidence was perpetually high and unshakable, turning it into a "Rainbow-Radiant Unicorn."
9116.desc: Bringing this Curio into a "#{room_comp_type:9}" Domain will decrease the Domain's time limit by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>

9130.name: Contemplation Disc
9130.lore: Under the gentle caress of the Chrysalis of Gold, even the stoniest of hearts can grasp the essence of love. Butterflies etched melodies onto the stone disc as a testament to the beauty and art of the world — from majestic choral performances and solitary bardic verses to the distant calls of birds from the wilderness. In the praise song of the devout, the Contemplation Disc meticulously recreates every note, making it an elegant tool for showcasing personal taste at social gatherings in Okhema. However, remember not to switch someone else's music casually, as this could provoke the wrath of Mnestia.

9131.name: Contemplation Disc
9131.lore: Under the gentle caress of the Chrysalis of Gold, even the stoniest of hearts can grasp the essence of love. Butterflies etched melodies onto the stone disc as a testament to the beauty and art of the world — from majestic choral performances and solitary bardic verses to the distant calls of birds from the wilderness. In the praise song of the devout, the Contemplation Disc meticulously recreates every note, making it an elegant tool for showcasing personal taste at social gatherings in Okhema. However, remember not to switch someone else's music casually, as this could provoke the wrath of Mnestia.
9131.desc: Immediately increases the level of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> random "#{room_comp_type:3}" Domain(s) by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>

9134.name: Sacrificial Javelin
9134.lore: For the warriors of Castrum Kremnos, war serves as a ritual sacrifice to Nikador. The ritual begins with the king's javelin — a spear infused with divine power that splits the night sky, its burst of light and heat capable of penetrating the strongest defenses and wiping entire city-states from the annals of history. King Agrysius sought to end this savage tradition by replacing bloodshed with competitive sport. Enraged, the citizens blinded him and banished him from the city, branding him a coward. Yet, some contend that this story was fabricated by his power-hungry brother as the old king's dying gaze remained fixed on his homeland.
9134.desc: Upon entering "#{room_comp_type:3}", "#{room_comp_type:23}", "#{room_comp_type:2}", or "#{room_comp_type:1}" Domains, gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments. Each successive entry additionally grants <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments. However, upon entering "#{room_comp_type:5}", "#{room_comp_type:8}", "#{room_comp_type:9}", or "#{room_comp_type:6}" Domains, loses <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments.

9138.name: Stone Mirror of Revelation
9138.lore: The expanse of land and sea can overwhelm even the learned scholars of Cerces, leading them astray. Only with Janus's blessing can true guidance be found. The Stone Mirror of Revelation generously unveils paths, offering just enough light to navigate during the nights when Aquila's all-seeing eyes are shut. At crucial times, the Fate Titans use the mirror to predict impending calamities, guiding people away from looming disasters with the flickering of stars. Even in its decline, the Gate of Infinity continues to offer its protection to the many descendants of Amphoreus.
9138.desc: Upon entering a "#{room_comp_type:3}" or "#{room_comp_type:5}" Domain, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> chance to gain <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> random Curio(s), which may include Negative Curios.

9146.name: Fruit of Whispered Wisdom
9146.lore: Knowledge requires a proper vessel to thrive, much like plants need fertile soil. The Grove Scholars have mastered the art of infusing sacred trees with knowledge and, with Cerces's blessing, they harvest fruits laden with wisdom. These Titan-blessed seeds carry more information than entire libraries and are sent to places in need, where they take root and flourish across the city-states of Amphoreus. However, be warned: Consuming these fruits will flood your mind with incessant whispers of knowledge, transforming you into a tree before you can resist.
9146.desc: Immediately obtain <unbreak>#{gblackboard:FruitBuffCount}[i]</unbreak> random Blessing(s). After losing this Curio, you will obtain it again and increase the number of Blessings rewarded by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>, up to a maximum of <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>

9153.name: Bountiful Rolling Stone
9153.lore: Every planting season, the disciples of Georios repeatedly push the Bountiful Rolling Stone up a hill, then let it thunderously roll down, crushing over the fields to be cultivated. This isn't just a fitness exercise. The rolling stone not only scatters fertile seeds but also enriches the soil with nutrients. However, never disturb them during their work. Mischievous children who chased after the stone ended up crushed as if they were part of the field. Though the children survived, their hair turned to wheat.
9153.desc: When entering the Third Plane and when obtaining this Curio in the Third Plane, Mask level +<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>.

9156.name: Kill That Butterfly
9156.lore: The process of annihilating a chaotic system is like making a specimen. Pin the information on every particle on the board and still the wings, then bind the butterfly's path and make reality dance in the way you want it to. Any tiny change would instantly disintegrate the fragile balance. No matter how much the scholars continue to perfect the model, they could only consider the foolish act of unifying the pattern of movement as the hubris of mortals. Therefore, I still clearly remember the first day I killed the butterfly, even though it was so long ago. I remember how the point of the knife stabbed into its chest.
9156.desc: After opening a total of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Chest(s), obtain 1 random Escapade-type Domain, then discard this Curio.

9158.name: Deep Sleep
9158.lore: Scholars typically resolve their differences through papers and debates, but for the Armed Archaeologists, physical intervention proves more effective. Deep Sleep was invented for the purpose: When the lampshade shatters, its wave-like particles permeate solid walls, inducing infant-like sleep in those who breathe them in. However, always measure the wind direction before use, especially avoiding downwind deployments.
9158.desc: Immediately increases the level of one random "#{room_comp_type:9}" Domain by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>. Obtain <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragment(s) upon entering a "#{room_comp_type:9}" Domain. Reward rank upon completing the Domain increases by <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>.

9165.name: Goodluck Cookie
9165.lore: Whether they are novice pickpockets or infamous master thieves, they always keep a few Goodluck Cookies in their pockets. These are dry, travel-friendly rations with a rather unappealing taste, rumored to be a recipe personally devised by their grandmaster, Zagreus. The ingredients are simple — just common ingredients like flour, butter, sugar, and salt — but if one happens to bite into the piece containing a hidden coin, they are said to receive the Titan's blessing. This might explain the cookie's odd texture and why so many thieves are missing a corner of a tooth, but who cares? As long as it brings good luck, it's worth the risk.
9165.desc: Immediately increases the level of one "#{room_comp_type:7}" Domain by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>. After spending a total of <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments in a single "#{room_comp_type:7}" Domain, immediately returns <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments. This effect can only trigger once per "#{room_comp_type:7}" Domain.

9168.name: Steeltorso Massage Device
9168.lore: The kins of Nikador are feared across Amphoreus as relentless war machines, owing not only to the power bestowed by the Strife Titan, but also to their exceptional logistical upkeep. After every battle, the Kremnoans use specially designed massage devices to relax the kins' bodies. These instruments deliver rapid dozens-per-second strikes, effectively loosening stiff joints and enhancing combat readiness. The only drawback? The devices have a notoriously short lifespan. However, the Kremnoans soon discovered that even after retirement, these massage tools could still serve a rather effective role in the interrogation of prisoners of war.
9168.desc: Replace all "#{room_comp_type:3}" Domains with "#{room_comp_type:2}" Domains. When entering "#{room_comp_type:3}" or "#{room_comp_type:2}" Domains, there's a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> chance to receive one "Absolute Failure Prescription."

9174.name: Wishing Scales
9174.lore: There is a well-known saying in Amphoreus: "Observe patterns, summarize patterns, utilize patterns." A certain missionary of Talanton was undoubtedly the finest practitioner of this philosophy. She took advantage of how Talanton's sacred scales would automatically rebalance to get people to make wishes on one side of the scales, and if the wish was fulfilled, an equivalent reward would manifest on the other side. In other words, if the wish failed, no harm was done. If it succeeded, the reward was doubled. Through this miraculous display, many came to recognize Talanton's power and willingly became devoted followers.
9174.desc: This Curio is destroyed after entering <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Domain(s). If you possess <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> or more Cosmic Fragments when this Curio is destroyed, gain <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Equation(s) of 3-star rarity and <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> Blessing(s) required to complete Equations

9177.name: Doors' Other Side
9177.lore: From a certain perspective, the priests of Janus and the thieves of Zagreus share a common interest — their study of all sorts of doors. The difference lies in their methods: The former approaches them through scholarship, while the latter relies on the art of thievery. This is why a legendary artifact said to unlock all doors became a point of contention between the two factions. The struggle continued until the master thief Lykos managed to steal it from the Temple of Janus. Seeking to test its power, he discovered that the artifact indeed opened any door, but only to a random location on the other side. With this revelation, the thieves quickly lost interest.
9177.desc: Immediately increases the level of all "#{room_comp_type:5}" Domains by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>, and decreases the level of all "#{room_comp_type:8}" Domains to Lv. 1.

9178.name: Triangular Drum-roll Device
9178.lore: In the age when Ena the Order still lived, extraordinary leaps in civilization on certain planets would be accompanied by pure and fortuitous hymns congratulating them from far away. These songs of praise resembled divine blessings and their melody were not limited to the form of the traditional octave, with their harmonies creating ever-new combinations, never duplicating. The Beyond-the-Sky Choir revered how this melody infinitely varied and yet always stayed within the realms of "Order," thus seeking to create a Triangular Drum-roll Device to replicate this infinite spectrum of notes.
9178.desc: When obtaining this Curio, overwrite up to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> random Equation(s), then obtain <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Blessing(s) required to complete Equations

9179.name: Beastmaster's Rein Wheel
9179.lore: Still struggling to pass the dromas-riding exam? Why not try this Georios-blessed rein wheel? Crafted with the secret techniques of the Era Chrysea and designed ergonomically for a firm grip, it is plug-and-play — allowing you to effortlessly control anything with four legs, be it a dromas, a carriage, or even a table. Friendly reminder: Due to the overwhelming power of Georios's blessing, be sure to hold on tight and control your speed while using it.
9179.desc: During the Draw phase, reduces the number of draws by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> (minimum 1). Destroyed after entering <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Domain(s).

9180.name: Dragon Bone Shield
9180.lore: Skiana is a small coastal city on the fringes of Amphoreus, long plagued by sea beast attacks. Eventually, under the leadership of a heroic captain, the city repelled the creatures and even recovered a severed limb from one of them. The remains were dragged back to the city. Though its flesh had rotted away, the bones were as hard as iron and as smooth as jade. The city's most skilled craftspeople ground the bones into shields, impervious to blades and spears, bringing great fame to the island. But with fame came war. The Kremnoans set their sights on these divine armors, and in the end, even the shields could not withstand their spears.
9180.desc: Attach a "#{room_attribute:110}" or "#{room_attribute:111}" beacon to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> designated "#{room_comp_type:3}" Domain(s), then remove <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> "#{room_comp_type:2}" Domain(s) with the lowest level(s).

9182.name: Window of Fortune
9182.lore: Travelers who have visited Dolos are always struck by its architecture, especially the half-crying, half-smiling windows. In this gambling-obsessed city-state, fortunes can change overnight. A billionaire today might lose every last Balance Coin by tomorrow. As a result, the people of Dolos are almost fanatical about luck, and these windows are believed to shift one's fortunes. When the people swing open the shutters and let the morning sunlight wash over them, yesterday's bad luck fades away, and they are ready to try their luck at the tables once again.
9182.desc: For every <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> "#{room_comp_type:5}," "#{room_comp_type:8}," or "#{room_comp_type:4}" Domains you have entered in total, obtain <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Curio(s) and lose <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Curio(s). All allies' CRIT DMG increases by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> for every time this Curio takes effect.

9183.name: Medal of the Gloryblood Era
9183.lore: A hundred Amber Eras after the proliferation of the Amber Era system and the Synesthesia Beacon, interstellar trade continued to develop and resource exchange became a pressing matter. A few planets ascended to become bustling interstellar hubs, signaling the onset of the Second Prosperity termed the "Gloryblood Era." The Second Prosperity endured for nearly five hundred Amber Eras before entering a gradual decline, but not even the apocalyptic Interstellar Energy War could erase its resplendent achievements. At the same time, Nous the Erudition unexpectedly terminated their calculations regarding the mysteries of the universe.
9183.desc: After entering an "#{room_comp_type:5}" Domain, <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Occurrence(s) will appear. This Curio is destroyed after this effect has triggered <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s). After being destroyed, "#{room_comp_type:5}" Domains will only contain <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Occurrence(s).

9184.name: Quiz With No Prize
9184.lore: A notebook of quizzes that once circulated on a small scale on the Herta Space Station. Parts of it were copied from Herta's childhood notebook. Just opening it will leave the reader stunned with incomprehensible numbers and formulas and inflict prolonged self-doubt. It's rumored that any researcher who can independently solve a single question in the book will receive the chance to converse face-to-face with the great Madam Herta. Though no one had been able to verify that rumor to date, this book was still sold out in seconds thanks to the fans and became a legendary collector's tome that has gone out of print.
9184.desc: You can battle Herta in "#{room_comp_type:7}" Domains. Upon victory, you will randomly obtain <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> item(s) from the Curio Store and lose this Curio. The Curio Store will then disappear from the current "#{room_comp_type:7}" Domain.

9185.name: Towat Cards
9185.lore: Dr. Riddle always styled himself as the archrival of Riddler Baden Babbibalo Bala. Using twenty-eight types of grammatical mistakes and thirty-six semantic changes to create a set of Towat cards, replacing soothsayers' Tawot cards with his invention instead. The chaos from the disarray of word sequences and discourse ultimately replaced the ambiguous reality with the divination's declared truth. When everything becomes jarringly paradoxical before you, it may not be the world that has changed, but the eyes of those who see it.
9185.desc: The Third Plane's boss is "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare (Complete)." When entering combat in the Third Plane's "#{room_comp_type:1}" Domain, DMG dealt by all allies increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>

9188.name: Black Hole Sugar Maker
9188.lore: Genius Society 3 Nyul Iman once recreated a black hole in her laboratory, and people speculated she was seeking the essence of Nihility. Three weeks later, she modified the Synthetic Black Hole into a cotton candy machine that automatically dispensed sweets to passing children, which led onlookers to suspect her true study was Voracity. The Fools offered a simpler hypothesis: perhaps she was just curious about what a black hole might taste like. In the end, she made far too much for one person to ever eat alone.
9188.desc: When successively entering identical Domains, greatly increases the chance for additional treasures to appear.

9190.name: Featherlight Inscription
9190.lore: Planet Nikota has complex and solemn funeral traditions. Residents hold grand ceremonies for the deceased, and the government has laws prohibiting the desecration of tombstones. As time passed, the planet gradually became occupied by tombstones, leaving less and less living space for the living. Masked Fool Urima lived on Nikota for <unbreak>40</unbreak> years, attending thousands of funerals where guests would weep endlessly, with no hint of joy. So he planned a special funeral for himself: in front of everyone, his tombstone sprouted thrusters and soared into the sky to pounding beats, the exhaust flames burning an epitaph into the grass: "Come on, smile! Isn't it vast out there?"
9190.desc: After entering a "#{room_comp_type:5}," "#{room_comp_type:8}," or "#{room_comp_type:4}" Domain, the number of Occurrences that appear increases by 1 (max 4). This Curio has a chance to be discarded after entering these Domains.

9192.name: Sage's Leaf Robe (Dormant)
9192.desc: When obtaining this Curio, immediately gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> 1-star Blessing(s). After achieving victory in "#{room_comp_type:2}" and "#{room_comp_type:4}" Domains, gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> random Blessing(s) of 1- to 3-star rarity. This Curio can be leveled up through Occurrences.

9193.name: Sage's Leaf Robe (Awakened)
9193.desc: When obtaining this Curio, immediately gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> 2-star Blessing(s). After achieving victory in "#{room_comp_type:2}" and "#{room_comp_type:4}" Domains, gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> random Blessing(s) of 1- to 3-star rarity. This Curio can be leveled up through Occurrences.

9194.name: Sage's Leaf Robe (Exalted)
9194.desc: When obtaining this Curio, immediately gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> 3-star Blessing(s). After achieving victory in "#{room_comp_type:2}" and "#{room_comp_type:4}" Domains, gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> random Blessing(s) of 1- to 3-star rarity.

9201.name: Minotaur Hunt
9201.lore: A set of treasure maps that dynamically track monsters. In the labyrinthine hunting grounds of Planet Minotaur, hunting Minotaurs was once an incredibly popular activity. However, as Minotaurs faced extinction due to environmental degradation, the activity was forcibly suspended two Amber Eras ago. Nevertheless, conservation specialists from the Intelligentsia Guild have implanted tracking chips in every surviving Minotaur and developed a rather reliable population recovery plan. Perhaps in the near future, people will once again be able to shout that classic hunter line in the maze: "Holy cow, there's a bull!"
9201.desc: When entering a Domain, if the Cosmic Fragments reach <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> or more, immediately obtains a Lv. 5 "#{room_comp_type:7}" Domain with a "#{room_attribute:128}" beacon. This effect is destroyed after triggering.

9202.name: Supreme Glue
9202.lore: When the Golden Banana Planet split into several pieces due to a forbidden experiment, Dr. Primitive merely chuckled and pulled out the Supreme Glue from his pocket, sticking the planetary fragments back together. No one knew why Dr. Primitive initially invented this overpowered adhesive until one day, while evading Rangers' pursuit, he deliberately scattered some mass-produced Supreme Glue across the universe for passing merchant ships to collect. This genius creation that could "fix anything" instantly caused an uproar across the cosmos. Some used it to build houses, while others installed bombs. One even tried to mend a broken relationship, and when that failed, they settled for gluing themself to their partner, never to part again.
9202.desc: When obtaining a Blessing, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> chance to obtain <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> random additional Blessing(s) of 1- to 2-star rarity. A maximum of <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Blessings can be obtained in this way.

9203.name: Eye of Overseer
9203.lore: During Cerydra's reign, faith in Talanton flourished like never before. Many people took it upon themselves to crack down on law violations, begging Talanton to pass judgment on all sorts of trivial matters, but the Scale of Justice rarely responded. It was then that the "Eye of Overseer" came into being. It could record sights and sounds to help courts reach verdicts, and could only be used by true believers of Talanton. Before the Flame-Chase Journey began, all Eyes of Overseer were destroyed, as too many people discovered they weren't true believers of Talanton after all.
9203.desc: After entering a Domain, loses <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragment(s). When this Curio is lost, obtain <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> random Curio(s) of 3-star rarity.

9212.name: Absolute Failure Prescription (Extra Strength)
9212.lore: Warfare is the plague of civilization. It erases lives, destroys history, and makes the world return to naught. The Doctors of Chaos mix the saliva of Inquisition Spirits with hair from Xenohydros, then offer a drop of their own blood. The potions made in this manner would interfere with the combat officers' decision-making, causing both sides to avoid all effective tactics, removing the possibility of armed conflict from its root. Will wars end because of this? The Doctors of Chaos believe that the plague will eventually be cured as long as people keep taking their medicine.
9212.desc: Decreases ally targets' CRIT Rate by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>

9221.name: Perilous Memory Storage
9221.lore: The Memosnatcher Mausolea once issued a heist notice to the Governor of Merlo Sector, threatening to steal and publicize the deepest secrets within his mind. To counter her threat, the governor commissioned the Intelligentsia Guild to develop this storage device. He transferred <unbreak>2,136</unbreak> memory segments marked "High Risk" into it, intending to destroy them with the push of a button when the time came. When the Memosnatcher arrived, the hard drive failed to function as anticipated, since the Governor had long forgotten how to operate it. Ultimately, however, it still repelled the Memosnatcher when thrown directly at her. After all, it is a high-density block of information, which is effectively a brick to a memetic lifeform.

9222.name: Flatbread
9222.lore: Before the Second Great Prosperity, interstellar travel was an absolute slog. Limited by the technology of the time, ships often took months just to cross a star system, while long-distance voyages were measured in years. Many sailors would end up losing themselves in the boundless cosmos, succumbing to depression or delirium, even treating the control console as their best friend. To assist in crew psychological intervention, a Doctor of Chaos named Pino invented "Positive Emotion Hardtack." Consumers would recall the happiest moments of their lives, enabling them to do anything with a positive attitude. However, after its widespread adoption, many employees used it during performance reviews to derive happiness from working overtime. The IPC quickly banned the production of these hardtacks. Nowadays, people must rely on their own strength to confront the sense of desolate emptiness.
9222.desc: When a Domain is leveled up, gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> random Blessing(s) of 1- to 2-star rarity. This effect can only trigger 1 time per Domain. This Curio is destroyed after this effect triggers <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s)

9223.name: Terminal Defender
9223.lore: The Interastral Entertainment Network brought a trendy new wave of entertainment to Planarcadia, much to the distaste of many Fools at the tavern. By blasting it with trashy short videos and relentless gaslighting every day, a Masked Fool named Empath finally nurtured a "Terminal Guard" plant. Fueled by a hatred for online chaos, every one of its leaves can purify over 1 Tbps of data, automatically blocking objectionable content on terminals. Following the successful experiment, Empath placed these plants in restrooms all over Planarcadia, only to find them swiftly removed by other people, since virtually all internet content was deemed "objectionable" by the Guard. More importantly, with such powerful blocking features, it really didn't look like a plant anymore.
9223.desc: When losing a Domain, gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragment(s). This Curio is destroyed after this effect triggers 3 times.

9224.name: Armed Archaeological Shovel
9224.lore: Armed Archaeologists are truly the oddballs of the Intelligentsia Guild. Many scholars in this faction are obsessed with combining weaponry and excavation tools, just so they can come in handy at critical moments. <unbreak>15</unbreak> Amber Eras ago, an archaeological team from the Sandridge-III Observation Station landed on a planet's surface, intending to study the remains of a Swarm King stranded there. However, a swarm of True Stings buried deep underground suddenly revived during the sampling process. The team suffered heavy casualties, leaving only their leader, Slay, alive. He held out alone on the planet for 5 years, continuing the excavation while fighting off the incoming Swarm with his armed archaeological shovel. Yet, when the IPC fleet arrived for the rescue, Slay resisted violently, eventually choosing to end his own life due to the "unshakable buzzing" in his head.
9224.desc: Immediately obtains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> random beacon(s). Upon entering a Domain, if you possess <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> or more beacons, upgrades to "#{miracle:excel_3}."

9225.name: Mining Dust Collector
9225.lore: Nomadic miners don't always mine deposits — the Terramite-III is a massive airship designed specifically for mining planets, integrating residential, refining, and other functional modules. The giant drill it carries can directly shatter an entire asteroid, with surrounding tractor beams collecting the debris. It is said that a certain miner group violated the *Interastral Security Treaty* by using this ship to strip away an entire continent from the planet Olander. But the locals were more amazed by the thing's appearance than what the planet had lost, since it looked exactly like a vacuum robot from Interastral Peace Appliances, just magnified tens of millions of times. The miners, meanwhile, admit it's one of their most trusted designs.
9225.desc: Immediately increases the level of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> random "#{room_comp_type:4}" Domain(s) by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>. After entering a total of 3 "#{room_comp_type:4}" Domains, upgrades to "#{miracle:excel_3}."

9226.name: Cosmic Drifter Fish
9226.lore: In the asteroid belt of Apex Segmentum, there wanders a silicon-based lifeform known as the drifter fish. For the most part, they move by drifting, slow as space junk, and were once ranked in the top five of the "Least Dangerous Intellitrons." That is, until the Second Emperor's War, when people discovered that their fin-like tails actually concealed high-energy thrusters capable of reaching one-tenth the speed of light in just thirty seconds at full power. In the end, the Marketing Development Department paid the price of the entire Third Fleet to "exterminate" the drifter fish. However, in the Solar Sailboat Competition held in <unbreak>2120</unbreak> AE, the IPC representative Hekas Iron-Eye took first place using four drifter fish as propulsion, declaring the domestication of the species complete.
9226.desc: When obtaining the highest tier Reward in a "#{room_comp_type:9}" Domain, attaches 1 random beacon to 1 designated Domain. This Curio is destroyed after this effect triggers 2 times.

9227.name: Vonwacq Souvenir
9227.lore: Wacq Island on Vonwacq is one of the most biodiverse places in the universe. Unlike other islands, every creature here has a lethal gimmick. The Six-Toothed Flower is the weakest plant of the lot, as its teeth are only as hard as diamonds, and it hunts far slower than the average animal, nearly causing its extinction. Outsiders arriving on Wacq Island recognized the value of Six-Toothed Flowers and brought them to the Interastral Peace Market. After generations of selective breeding, the plant became both beautiful and safe, sparking a brief wave of hype. It's said its popularity comes from the realization people have while looking at it: In Vonwacq, you're nothing but a seed.
9227.desc: Upon entering a Domain with a beacon, obtains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragment(s). This Curio is destroyed after this effect triggers 3 times.

9228.name: Wishing Nickel
9228.lore: In the Canvas Age, almost everyone could consume Wishpower, and Wishing Nickels were the most accessible medium. Whatever was written on them had a probability of coming true as long as one was pious enough. Initially, people pinned their hopes for a better life on the nickels: Romance, promotions, or just having a good day... But after spending too many years in the Eternal Canvas, the wishes people made grew increasingly distorted, such as sending their neighbors spiraling into the sky or paving the roads with banana peels. The Worlds Reborn Initiative did not salvage these Wishing Nickels, which was why some residents preferred to remain in the painting, continuing their game of mutual wish-making.
9228.desc: Immediately increases the level of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> random "#{room_comp_type:7}" Domain(s) and <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> random "#{room_comp_type:21}" Domain(s) by <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>.

9229.name: Inspiration Glass Ball
9229.lore: A brilliant reversal, a meticulous deduction, a novel framework... All those elusive flashes of inspiration across every field vanish in an instant, leading to immense intellectual waste. Leveraging Memory Bubble technology, the Candelagraphos created specialized containers to preserve such sparks, classifying them by quality into different colors: the finest in orange, the poorest in blue. Yet before The Riddlers could intervene, they voluntarily abandoned the research. After all, realizing an idea is far more difficult than proposing it. And for the planet's elite researchers, if a suggestion goes unadopted, it might as well be forgotten.
9229.desc: Instantly maxes out <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Domain(s) that aren't at max level
